top_signals.title: Iran, US Harden Stances as Pakistan Says Deal Is Near
top_signals.summary: Pakistan’s defense minister said the US and Iran are “close to some sort of arrangement” over the Strait of Hormuz, even after both sides appeared to toughen their positions in the long-deadlocked negotiations.  Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan Boosts Singapore Stocks Target as Economic Growth Holds
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. raised its target for Singapore stocks as robust economic growth and a narrowing valuation gap with developed-market peers bolster their outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indonesian Tech Firm GoTo Faces MSCI Index Exclusion in Review
top_signals.summary: GoTo Group, the Indonesian ride-hailing and food delivery platform once valued at more than $32 billion, faces the prospect of being dropped from MSCI Inc.’s indexes on Wednesday after a plunge in its share price left the stock difficult to trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Retail investors are returning to UK markets
top_signals.summary: For decades, British retail investors have snubbed their home market. But in 2026 things are changing, writes Rupert Hargreaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
